market: US (Nasdaq: AAOI) — manufacturing facilities in Sugar Land TX and Taipei Taiwan

evidence.claim: Texas fab expansion operational: Sugar Land 210,000 sq ft + Pearland buildings enabling 650,000 units/month 800G+1.6T capacity; 30%+ manufactured in Texas by end 2026 — domestic US capacity for trusted-supplier procurement mandates
evidence.source: Derived from GlobeNewswire February 13, 2026 (groundbreaking); Q1 2026 earnings capacity guidance

evidence.claim: CPO pump laser volume production: 400mW BH DFB laser for silicon photonics sampling late 2026; volume production H1 2027; positions AAOI in CPO architecture at two layers (transceiver module + laser source for external silicon photonics)
evidence.source: Derived from GlobeNewswire December 18, 2025 (product introduction); Q1 2026 earnings call timeline

evidence.claim: 1.6T becomes volume product: Q3 2026 shipments begin from March 2026 order; H1 2027 represents first full half-year of 1.6T revenue; next-generation AI cluster connectivity standard requires 1.6T modules at scale
evidence.source: Derived from GlobeNewswire March 9, 2026 (order confirmation with Q3 2026 start); industry 1.6T adoption timeline

evidence.claim: Oracle qualification completion: Rosenblatt analyst cited Oracle as 'imminent qualification target' in May 2026; if successful, adds a third major hyperscale direct customer alongside Microsoft and Amazon, reducing customer concentration risk
evidence.source: Rosenblatt analyst note cited in Yahoo Finance, May 2026

evidence.claim: Full-year 2026 guidance >$1.1B revenue; CEO states actual demand $1.4-1.5B; implied 2027 trajectory toward $1.5-2.0B if capacity ramp succeeds and CATV/data center mix improves further toward data center
evidence.source: AAOI Q1 2026 earnings call, BigGo Finance May 7, 2026

what_could_weaken_view: Texas fab execution failure: InP epitaxy at 650,000 units/month is unprecedented scale; defect density, yield management, and process qualification on new buildings with new equipment simultaneously could delay capacity ramp 6-12 months

CATV market structural decline: if North American cable operators reduce DOCSIS 4.0 capex (rate sensitivity, streaming competition), Digicomm channel revenue falls — compressed overall revenue growth masks or reverses data center gains

Silicon photonics CPO with quantum dot lasers displaces AAOI in the next architecture: if QD laser technology matures faster than expected (see Sivers/ALRIB thesis), the InP CW DFB laser for CPO becomes commoditized or replaced before AAOI achieves meaningful CPO revenue

GAAP profitability remains elusive despite >$1B revenue — if operating leverage does not emerge at scale (gross margins don't expand beyond 30-32%), the equity narrative shifts from growth to distressed; additional dilutive raises follow

Chinese transceiver makers receive tariff exemption or partner with US entities: InnoLight and HG Genuine have scale advantages; any route to direct US hyperscaler access would compress AAOI's pricing power
